analysis: The PR under test only changes Aspire.Dashboard server-side lock initialization code and its unit test, with no changes to the VS Code extension or its E2E tests. This shard has a documented history of intermittent Selenium-webdriver wait timeouts on the AppHosts tree/section text in the Windows apphost-tree shard, indicating UI update timing flakiness rather than a code regression from this PR.
